title: WordPress Tags Config
description: Source-of-truth config for a project's WordPress blog tag taxonomy. Applied by scripts/wordpress/setup_tags.py AND consulted by scripts/wordpress/wp_publisher.py on every article publish (tag get-or-create). Robots policy is per-project (policy.default_robots); niche sites default to index-by-default with curated descriptions.

strategic_tags.description: Tags that earn full SEO treatment with rank_math_robots=['index']. Promotion criteria from policy.promote_to_index_criteria must be met.

baseline_tags.description: Tags that get name + slug + axis classification + curated description. Indexed by default per policy (project-charlie pattern). Brand mentions, technical synonyms, axis-fill tags. Differs from strategic_tags by editorial investment, not capability: baseline entries MAY carry curated rank_math_title / rank_math_description / rank_math_focus_keyword (loamwright 2026-07-06 pattern); when absent, the RankMath global tag template applies.

delete_tags.description: Tags to remove from the live site. Setup script deletes after migrating any posts to the strategic-tag merge target.

description_template.description: Template for auto-generated descriptions. {name} interpolates the tag name. DELIBERATELY null in canonical configs (post-2026-05-23) — templated descriptions are the hidden anti-pattern; see feedback_tag_description_must_be_tag_centric.

merge_from_slugs.description: Legacy tag slugs to merge INTO this tag. Setup script: re-tags posts from each legacy slug to this slug, then deletes the legacy tag.

description.description: Axis-aware unique description, 30-60 words. Should reference concrete products, specifications, or topics relevant to this tag — NOT a 'Articles tagged X on Site' tautology template. Falls back to template only for unknown organic tags resolved through the resolver, never for baseline_tags entries.

rank_math_robots.description: Defaults to policy.default_robots if omitted. Set explicitly per-tag if it should diverge from project policy.

rank_math_title.description: Optional curated SERP title. Passed through by setup_tags.py and tag_seo_resolver when present.
